advise_catalyst.text: Your output comes in bursts, and the slow work in between stays hidden. Give the thing you made to someone before you think it is finished. Tell one person about a plan you have kept quiet. Read one page you wrote to a friend. Send the text without rereading it.

advise_friction.text: Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the cold side water forms on. It pulls from the air and hands the water back to its source. Let it hold what Wood pours out. Nothing you let out will fill you back up. Read one whole chapter before you make the next thing. Let one question sit overnight.

advise_catalyst.text: Most of your chances are lost by never being claimed, not by failing. Put a date on one venture and begin before it arrives. Ask for the raise instead of waiting for it. Tell the person you love what you want next. Once a week, buy the small thing you keep pricing.

Once a week, buy the small thing you keep pricing.

advise_friction.text: Seek Water, your own Body energy. Water is the deep you draw from, the sleep and food and slow fill that come before anything is lit. Let it hold what Fire burns. Whether you are reaching for more or guarding what you have, the heat comes out of your own reserves. Keep one night a week unlit, in bed early.

advise_catalyst.text: You carry every line you live by alone, since few deadlines come to you from outside. Put yourself under one. Sign up for the race, the exam or the course with a date on it. Tell one person above you what you will deliver and when. Keep one standing rule at home, the same sleep hour every night.

Sign up for the race, the exam or the course with a date on it.

Keep one standing rule at home, the same sleep hour every night.

advise_friction.text: Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the clear line that sorts a demand into what is asked and what is feared. Let it hold what Earth presses on you. You take each demand as a judgement on yourself. Before your next big yes, ask one person who has made the same call, and write down what they say.

advise_catalyst.text: You let in less than the world has to offer, and the gap shows when a question needs more than you hold. Keep one book going that is harder than you need. Ask someone older how they did it, and hear them out to the end. Sleep on any answer that matters. Write the question down before you reply.

Write the question down before you reply.

advise_friction.text: Seek Fire, the Action energy. Fire melts what has gone hard, so a checked thought becomes an act and the extra look burns off. Let it spend what Metal stores. Each extra round of care buys you safety and costs you a move. Ship one piece as a draft. Decide one small thing with no second look.

advise_catalyst.text: Every push you make draws on a reserve that was small to begin with. Take in before you spend. Sleep a full night ahead of any decision that matters, and let one peer carry half of a shared task. Ask a friend for the whole answer rather than guessing it. Eat lunch sitting down.

advise_friction.text: Seek Earth, the Order energy. Earth is the bank: it gives moving water a path and a shore. Let it shape what your Water pours. You hold more than you move, and what you do not move turns into weight. Hand someone above you a finish date in writing, then clear one small job today.
